cases.stdout:
usage: herdr-theme workspace [-h] [--agents | --shells] [--tiers TIERS] [--by BY]
                    name folder

Create a workspace with ONE coordinating Claude session. More panes are added
later by the harness `dispatch` when work arrives, and finished panes are
closed by the observer. --tiers <tier> opens that one pane on the model for
the tier (low|mid|high|max, default high). The plan is kept in
data/sixfold/space-tiers.json. A site.local.json "new_space_tiers" list (old
six-pane setting) is used only as a fallback: its first value, with a warning.
Tier -> model and effort come from "model_tiers" (ADR-0008,
scripts/model_tier.py).

positional arguments:
  name
  folder

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --agents
  --shells
  --tiers TIERS  tier of the single session (low|mid|high|max, default high)
  --by BY        who decided the tiers (default: this session)

usage: herdr-theme route [-h] [--from SOURCE] [--drain] [--reply]
                [--tier {low,mid,high,max}] [--enable]
                [project] [text]

Route Common workspace tasks to the same project slot, with idle fallback.

positional arguments:
  project
  text

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --from SOURCE
  --drain
  --reply               request one explicit result reply
  --tier {low,mid,high,max}
                        작업 난이도 low|mid|high(기본): 같은 모델 세션 먼저, 없으면 더 높은 모델, 낮은
                        모델엔 보내지 않음
  --enable              enable the sidebar queue drain for this checkout
